name: ITPR paralog mine (Compara)
description: Phylogenomic hunt for unnamed / novel ITPR-family genes. Mines Ensembl Compara gene trees for every within-species paralog of ITPR1/2/3 across a 7-species vertebrate panel (human, mouse, zebrafish, chicken, frog, platypus, elephant shark), fetches protein sequences, and is designed to be run with analysis + discovery so unnamed gene models surface as scored candidates. Adjacent family loci are auto-flagged as possible split annotations. NOTE: Compara gene trees put ITPRs and RYRs in one tree, so the paralog list will include ryanodine receptors — they are the sister family, not novel ITPRs, and the size band plus the RyR-specific Pfam domains separate them.
